description: This source file handles network device status reporting using Avro serialization, schema management, and WebPA messaging in a network management context.

methods.name: GetNDStatusSchemaBuffer
methods.description: Returns the buffer containing the network device status schema.

methods.name: GetNDStatusSchemaBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the schema buffer.

methods.name: GetNDStatusSchemaIDBuffer
methods.description: Returns the schema ID buffer string.

methods.name: GetNDStatusSchemaIDBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the length of the schema ID buffer.

methods.name: NumberofElementsinLinkedList
methods.description: Counts the number of elements in a linked list of network device status data.

methods.name: prepare_writer_status
methods.description: Prepares an Avro writer with schema and serialization headers.

methods.name: network_devices_status_report
methods.description: Generates and sends a network devices status report in Avro format via WebPA.

methods.name: nds_avro_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up allocated resources related to Avro schema and buffers.
